evidence_class: Scoped fixture grants, fake Redis server time, fakeredis, real isolated SQLite repository and mocked GitHub provider. Live G3 qualification is separate.
interfaces: Proposal binds task generation, task revision, PR identity, tested head and artifact/run proof
Outcomes.propose authenticates scope and current ownership before journalling accepted proposals
Outcomes.integrate reserves one provider dispatch, checks current ownership at the final guard and reconciles queue and merge identifiers
GitHubIntegration restricts the repository and dev base, rechecks the actual PR and enqueues with expectedHeadOid
Outcomes.complete commits the authoritative SQLite task through CompletionGate before completing TaskAuthority; immutable effect receipts permit replay after interruption or owner replacement
Legacy merge and done commands reject distributed tasks before provider or ledger mutations; merge verifies the recorded PR and all duplicate task links
Committed receipt fields cannot be overwritten by legacy task updates
Outcomes.outcome_conflicts_total exposes fixture scoped conflict counts

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards passed in the linked CI run
supported_versions.coordination: Accepted TaskAuthority scoped grants, generations, Redis journal fencing and controller lease
supported_versions.ledger: Existing SQLite LedgerRepository and transaction gate
supported_versions.provider: GitHub GraphQL PR node and expectedHeadOid enqueuePullRequest
supported_versions.compatibility: Explicitly local legacy done and merge behavior remains covered by passing existing CI tests

states.observed: Provider PR, tested head, queue entry and merge commit are read independently of worker success messages
states.accepted: Current owner evidence is bound to generation and task revision in the claim journal
states.committed: Provider queue admission is recorded while task authority remains active; SQLite done mutation stores an immutable effect receipt
states.externally_verified: Observed MERGED state plus merge commit allows ledger completion and then authority completion

validation.unit: All twelve Python unit shards passed; each acceptance case passed twice using independent fixture directories
validation.mutation: The cited run exposed survivors; subsequent test coverage and five Standards equivalent mutant rulings are pending new head CI
validation.review: Standards and Spec code reviews closed on e12eb73a; subsequent changes strengthen tests and evidence
validation.local: No local tests or mutation ran after the operator prohibition; static prepush passed on aa83d8e3

measurements.dimension: Each test has its own Redis swarm and authoritative ledger fixture

rollback_rehearsal.action: Set Outcomes.integration_enabled false and retain proposals for operator review
rollback_rehearsal.behavior: Pause before dispatch preserves accepted proposals; resuming dispatches once. Ambiguous unknown operations remain pending and are never blindly replayed.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: TaskClaim and journal, authenticated launch records, SQLite task and immutable outcome receipt, actual provider PR and commit

remaining_limitations: Live G3 deployment evidence is required at the rollout gate; mocked fixtures do not qualify a deployed system
Worker outcome HTTP transport is supplied by the remote ledger workstream; this package supplies the authenticated controller outcome and repository boundaries
Final authority check and provider HTTP write are separate operations; atomic provider generation fencing is not claimed
Unknown provider effects without observable queue or merge identity require reconciliation rather than automatic redispatch
Mutation qualification is pending new head CI
